title: The Unseen Connection Between Blood Types

scenes.text: Did you know that people with type O blood can donate to all other types?
Type O blood is the most common, making up about 45% of the population.
However, having type O blood can increase the risk for certain infections.
SURPRISINGLY, O BLOOD TYPES HAVE DISADVANTAGES!
scenes.reveal_top: O BLOOD IS NOT ALWAYS BEST

scenes.text: Follow for facts that sound fake but aren't.

description: Blood types hold secrets beyond compatibility! Discover why type O isn't always the best choice. Follow for more amazing insights!
